org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model

Class Constant

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model.Constant

  • @Entity
public class Constant
extends Object
    Entity representing the Constant database table. This table contains metadata for each constant and a string data value field. Data from the Constant database table is decoded and used to populate PhasingConstants, PrimaryMirrorConstants, PrimaryMirrorSegmentConstants, SufsConstants and TelescopeConstants
    Author:
    smichaels
